description: Query the iTunes Search API for music, podcasts, audiobooks and apps

apify_api_key.description: Your Apify API token (optional). When provided the actor runs live and returns real data. Get one free at https://apify.com/sign-up

ids_upcs_isbns.description: iTunes IDs, UPCs or ISBNs (used when mode = lookup)

media_type.description: Which part of the catalogue to search

mode.description: search = query by text term; lookup = fetch exact items by ID/UPC/ISBN

results_per_term.description: Max results returned per search term (1–200)

name: itunes_search
title: iTunes Search API — Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks & More
